import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(20, 16))

# 1. Top 10 dog breeds by count
ax1 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 1)
top_breeds = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
bars = ax1.barh(range(len(top_breeds)), top_breeds.values)
ax1.set_yticks(range(len(top_breeds)))
ax1.set_yticklabels(top_breeds.index, fontsize=9)
ax1.invert_yaxis()
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs')
ax1.set_title('Top 10 Dog Breeds in Zurich', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for i, v in enumerate(top_breeds.values):
    ax1.text(v + max(top_breeds.values)*0.01, i, str(v), va='center', fontsize=8)

# 2. Dog distribution by district
ax2 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 2)
district_counts = df['KreisLang'].value_counts().sort_index()
bars = ax2.bar(range(len(district_counts)), district_counts.values)
ax2.set_xticks(range(len(district_counts)))
ax2.set_xticklabels([f'Kreis {i+1}' for i in range(len(district_counts))], rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax2.set_xlabel('District')
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs')
ax2.set_title('Dog Distribution by District', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', which='major', labelsize=8)

# 3. Dog age distribution
ax3 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 3)
age_order = sorted(df['AlterVHundLang'].dropna().unique(), 
                   key=lambda x: int(x.split('-')[0]) if '-' in x else int(x.split()[0]))
age_counts = df['AlterVHundLang'].value_counts().reindex(age_order)
bars = ax3.bar(range(len(age_counts)), age_counts.values)
ax3.set_xticks(range(len(age_counts)))
ax3.set_xticklabels(age_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax3.set_xlabel('Dog Age Group')
ax3.set_ylabel('Count')
ax3.set_title('Dog Age Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Dog gender distribution
ax4 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 4)
gender_counts = df['SexHundLang'].value_counts()
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax4.pie(gender_counts.values, labels=gender_counts.index, 
                                   autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=sns.color_palette("Set2"))
ax4.set_title('Dog Gender Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 5. Owner age distribution
ax5 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 5)
owner_age_order = sorted(df['AlterV10Lang'].dropna().unique(), 
                         key=lambda x: int(x.split('-')[0]) if '-' in x else int(x.split()[0]))
owner_age_counts = df['AlterV10Lang'].value_counts().reindex(owner_age_order)
bars = ax5.bar(range(len(owner_age_counts)), owner_age_counts.values, color='skyblue')
ax5.set_xticks(range(len(owner_age_counts)))
ax5.set_xticklabels(owner_age_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax5.set_xlabel('Owner Age Group')
ax5.set_ylabel('Count')
ax5.set_title('Dog Owner Age Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 6. Dogs per year trend
ax6 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 6)
year_counts = df['StichtagDatJahr'].value_counts().sort_index()
ax6.plot(year_counts.index, year_counts.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=6)
ax6.set_xlabel('Year')
ax6.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs Registered')
ax6.set_title('Dog Registrations Over Time', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
for year, count in zip(year_counts.index, year_counts.values):
    ax6.text(year, count + max(year_counts.values)*0.02, str(count), 
             ha='center', fontsize=8)

# 7. Most common dog colors
ax7 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 7)
color_counts = df['HundefarbeText'].value_counts().head(8)
bars = ax7.barh(range(len(color_counts)), color_counts.values)
ax7.set_yticks(range(len(color_counts)))
ax7.set_yticklabels(color_counts.index, fontsize=9)
ax7.invert_yaxis()
ax7.set_xlabel('Count')
ax7.set_title('Most Common Dog Colors', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for i, v in enumerate(color_counts.values):
    ax7.text(v + max(color_counts.values)*0.01, i, str(v), va='center', fontsize=8)

# 8. Mixed vs pure breeds
ax8 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 8)
mixed_breed = df['Rasse2Text'].notna()
breed_type_counts = pd.Series({
    'Mixed Breed': mixed_breed.sum(),
    'Pure Breed': (~mixed_breed).sum()
})
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax8.pie(breed_type_counts.values, labels=breed_type_counts.index, 
                                   autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=['lightcoral', 'lightgreen'])
ax8.set_title('Mixed vs Pure Breeds', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 9. Dogs per owner gender
ax9 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 9)
owner_gender_counts = df['SexLang'].value_counts()
bars = ax9.bar(range(len(owner_gender_counts)), owner_gender_counts.values, 
               color=['steelblue', 'lightpink'])
ax9.set_xticks(range(len(owner_gender_counts)))
ax9.set_xticklabels(owner_gender_counts.index)
ax9.set_ylabel('Number of Dog Owners')
ax9.set_title('Dog Owners by Gender', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for i, v in enumerate(owner_gender_counts.values):
    ax9.text(i, v + max(owner_gender_counts.values)*0.01, str(v), 
             ha='center', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')

# Adjust layout and add main title
plt.suptitle('Zurich Dog Registration Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
